$comment: The templates the hub composes an app from, by role. A role with one option is filled without a flag; a role with several names the flag that chooses, and that flag is required. The option names here are what a person types at spin-up; each summary is the line the app's README gives that part.

react.summary: the front end: Vite + React + TypeScript, built to static files

node.summary: the server: Node + Express + TypeScript; serves the web build and the API under /api

dotnet.summary: the server: C# on .NET 11, an ASP.NET Core minimal API tested with xUnit; serves the web build and the API under /api

none.summary: the server: Node + Express + TypeScript; serves the web build (the app has no API)

cloud-run.summary: deploys the app's image to Google Cloud Run (cloudbuild.yaml, DEPLOY.md)
